time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t=0

camera.view: top-down (bird's-eye) view of a snowy mountain slope; the plane moves in a plane facing the camera

objects.name: plane
objects.description: small yellow/orange toy-like aeroplane seen from above (straight wing, tail stabiliser, nose pointing down the image)
objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y (blur-corrected bbox centre = assumed origin)

objects.name: dark_rock_outcrop_large
objects.description: large dark rock band near top-centre/right

objects.name: dark_rock_small
objects.description: small dark rock spire on right side below the big outcrop

objects.name: crevasses
objects.description: blue crevasse cracks at lower left/centre

objects.name: snow_ridge_edge
objects.description: bright snow cornice edge running from left (y~960-1000) to lower right; plane crosses it around y~1150 (frame ~57)

objects.name: pale_backdrop_top
objects.description: light grey angular rendered backdrop at the very top, y < ~200

events.event: plane starts from rest / motion start
events.note: quadratic fit of ref_y over frames 2-40 puts zero velocity at frame -0.04; frames 0-1 show the same position (sub-pixel move)

events.event: plane begins leaving bottom edge (nose cut)
plane mostly out of frame (only tail visible)

motion_summary: plane moves straight down the image (+y), x constant at ~671 px, speeding up the whole time; no bounce or turn
